title: Snapshot index bound
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $N,T,t\in\bbn$. Write $k$ for the number of work tapes of $M$. Then $t\bigl(k(2T+1)+N+3\bigr)+k(2T+1)+N+2 < (t+1)\bigl(k(2T+1)+N+3\bigr)$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet
